description: This file defines the interface 'FieldTypePluginManagerInterface' for managing field type plugins in Drupal, including methods for creating field item lists, retrieving settings, and getting plugin definitions.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Field\FieldTypePluginManagerInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing field type plugins, including creation of field items, retrieving settings, and plugin definitions.

methods.name: createFieldItemList
methods.description: Creates a new field item list for a given entity and field name, optionally with initial values.

methods.name: createFieldItem
methods.description: Creates a new field item within a field item list at a specified index, with optional values.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Retrieves default settings for a specified field type.

methods.name: getDefaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Retrieves default storage settings for a specified field type.

methods.name: getStorageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage-level settings for a field, given its storage definition.

methods.name: getFieldSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of field-level settings for a field, given its definition.

methods.name: getUiDefinitions
methods.description: Returns definitions of all field types available via UI.

methods.name: getEntityTypeUiDefinitions
methods.description: Returns field type definitions available via UI for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getPreconfiguredOptions
methods.description: Returns preconfigured options for a specific field type plugin.

methods.name: getPluginClass
methods.description: Returns the PHP class name that implements a given field type plugin.
